items.text:
struct node {
    int key_;
    struct node *next_;

typedef struct node node_t;

p->next_ = NULL;

    while(q != NULL) {

        free(q);

typedef struct node node_t;

struct mylist { node_t *head; };
typedef struct mylist mylist_t;

items.title: Implementation (mylist.c):
items.text:
void init_list(mylist_t* l) { l->head = NULL; }

void insert_list(mylist_t* l, int key) {
    node_t* temp = malloc(sizeof(node_t));
    temp->key_ = key; temp->next_ = NULL;

    if(l->head == NULL) {
        l->head = temp;
    } else {
        node_t *prev = NULL, *pres = l->head;
        while(pres && pres->key_ < key) {
            prev = pres; pres = pres->next_;
        }
        if(prev == NULL) {  // Beginning
            temp->next_ = pres;
            l->head = temp;
        } else {  // Middle or End
            temp->next_ = pres;
            prev->next_ = temp;
        }
    }
}

void disp_(node_t* q) {
    while(q) { printf("%d ", q->key_); q = q->next_; }
}
void disp_list(mylist_t* l) { disp_(l->head); printf("\n"); }

void free_list_(node_t* q) {
    node_t* r;
    while(q) { r = q->next_; free(q); q = r; }
}
void free_list(mylist_t* l) { free_list_(l->head); }

#include "mylist.h"
int main() {

    for(int i=0; i<5; ++i) insert_list(&l, a[i]);
    disp_list(&l);  // 10 20 30 40 50
    free_list(&l);
}

items.title: After: 1 Case! (from textbook p.94):
items.text:
void insert_list(mylist_t* ptr_list, int key)
{
    // create the node
    node_t* temp = (node_t*)malloc(sizeof(node_t));
    temp->key_ = key; temp->next_ = NULL;

    // traverse from header
    node_t* prev = ptr_list->head_;       // Start AT header
    node_t* pres = ptr_list->head_->next_; // First REAL node

    while(pres != NULL && pres->key_ < temp->key_)
    {
        prev = pres;
        pres = pres->next_;
    }

    // SINGLE insert statement for ALL cases!
    temp->next_ = pres;
    prev->next_ = temp;
}

items.title: Push (Insert at Head):
items.text:
void push(stack_t* s, char ch) {
    if (is_full(s)) return;  // See is_full below

    node_t* temp = malloc(sizeof(node_t));
    temp->key_ = ch;
    temp->next_ = s->top_;   // New node points to old top
    s->top_ = temp;          // top now points to new node
}
Order matters! temp->next_ = s->top_ BEFORE s->top_ = temp

items.title: Pop:
items.text:
char pop(stack_t* s) {
    if (is_empty(s)) return 0;

    char val = s->top_->key_;   // 1. Save value
    node_t* temp = s->top_;     // 2. Save node to free
    s->top_ = s->top_->next_;   // 3. Move top to next
    free(temp);                 // 4. Free old node
    return val;                 // 5. Return value
}
Order critical! Don't free before saving value/next.

items.title: Full (Heap Check):
items.text:
int is_full(stack_t* s) {
    node_t* temp = malloc(sizeof(node_t));
    if (!temp) return 1;   // Allocation failed
    free(temp);
    return 0;
}
Note: Allocates and frees test node — expensive but only way in C.

items.title: Deinit:
items.text:
void deinit_stack(stack_t* s) {
    while (!is_empty(s)) pop(s);  // Pop all nodes
}

items.title: Enqueue:
items.text:
void enque(queue_t* q, int key) {
    node_t* temp = malloc(sizeof(node_t));
    temp->key_ = key;
    temp->next_ = NULL;

    if (q->rear_ == NULL) {           // Empty queue
        q->front_ = q->rear_ = temp;  // Both front & rear
    } else {
        q->rear_->next_ = temp;       // Link at rear
        q->rear_ = temp;              // Update rear
    }
}
path: Unit 2: Circular Lists, Queues, Priority Queues

items.title: Dequeue:
items.text:
int deque(queue_t* q) {
    if (q->front_ == NULL) return 0;  // Empty

    node_t* temp = q->front_;
    int key = temp->key_;

    q->front_ = temp->next_;          // Move front
    if (q->front_ == NULL)            // Was last node?
        q->rear_ = NULL;              // Rear also NULL

    free(temp);
    return key;
}

items.text:
Problem: front == rear means both empty AND full!

Solution: Always keep one empty slot to distinguish.

items.title: Enqueue:
items.text:
void enque(queue_t* q, int key) {
    int next_rear = (q->rear_ + 1) % MAXSIZE;

    if (next_rear == q->front_) {  // Full?
        printf("queue full\n");
        return;
    }

    q->rear_ = next_rear;
    q->key_[q->rear_] = key;
}

Note: Increment rear first, then check full.

items.title: Dequeue:
items.text:
int deque(queue_t* q) {
    if (q->front_ == q->rear_) return 0;  // Empty

    int next_front = (q->front_ + 1) % MAXSIZE;
    int key = q->key_[next_front];
    q->front_ = next_front;
    return key;
}

Note: Check empty before incrementing front.

    return (q->rear_ + 1) % MAXSIZE == q->front_;

items.title: Insert (Returns Updated Root):
items.text:
void insert(tree_t* t, int key) {
    node_t* temp = malloc(sizeof(node_t));
    temp->key_ = key; temp->left_ = temp->right_ = NULL;
    t->root_ = insert_rec(t->root_, temp);
}

static node_t* insert_rec(node_t* root, node_t* temp) {
    if (!root) return temp;
    if (root->key_ > temp->key_)
        root->left_ = insert_rec(root->left_, temp);
    else
        root->right_ = insert_rec(root->right_, temp);
    return root;
}

void enque(queue_t* q, job_t* job) {
    node_t* temp = malloc(sizeof(node_t));
    temp->jobx_ = *job;
    temp->next_ = NULL;

    if (q->rear_ == NULL) {
        q->front_ = q->rear_ = temp;
    } else {
        q->rear_->next_ = temp;
        q->rear_ = temp;
    }
}

items.title: Dequeue: O(n) — Scan for max priority
items.text:
job_t deque(queue_t* q) {
    // Track max with two pointers
    node_t *prev = NULL, *pres = q->front_;
    node_t *max_prev = NULL, *max_pres = q->front_;
    int max_pri = get_priority(&pres->jobx_);

    // Scan entire list
    while (pres) {
        int pri = get_priority(&pres->jobx_);
        if (pri > max_pri) {
            max_pri = pri;
            max_prev = prev;
            max_pres = pres;
        }
        prev = pres;
        pres = pres->next_;
    }

    // Remove max_pres
    job_t job = max_pres->jobx_;
    if (max_prev == NULL) {           // Case A: First node
        q->front_ = max_pres->next_;
        if (!q->front_) q->rear_ = NULL;
    } else {                          // Case B: Middle/End
        max_prev->next_ = max_pres->next_;
        if (!max_pres->next_) q->rear_ = max_prev;
    }
    free(max_pres);
    return job;
}

items.title: Enqueue: O(n) — Insert in sorted position (highest at front)
items.text:
void enque(queue_t* q, job_t* job) {
    node_t* temp = create_node(job);

    if (q->front_ == NULL) {          // Empty
        q->front_ = q->rear_ = temp;
        return;
    }

    // Find insertion point (descending priority)
    node_t *prev = NULL, *pres = q->front_;
    int pri = get_priority(job);

    while (pres && get_priority(&pres->jobx_) >= pri) {
        prev = pres;
        pres = pres->next_;
    }

    if (!prev) {                      // Insert at front
        temp->next_ = q->front_;
        q->front_ = temp;
    } else if (!pres) {               // Insert at end
        q->rear_->next_ = temp;
        q->rear_ = temp;
    } else {                          // Middle
        temp->next_ = pres;
        prev->next_ = temp;
    }
}
